requirement_statement: One Strata row per (study, stratum) with Description.
name: ingest-adapter-strata

requirement_statement: One StratumVariables row with CausalRole and MechanismNote.
name: ingest-adapter-stratum-variable

mechanical_check: Exactly two Treatments rows per study.
name: ingest-adapter-treatments

requirement_statement: Exclude continuous outcomes without stated dichotomisation.
name: ingest-excl-continuous-outcome

requirement_statement: Exclude post-hoc stratum splitting to force a reversal.
mechanical_check: Stratum variable named in original publication.
name: ingest-excl-posthoc-strata

requirement_statement: Published or citable 2xK contingency table with aggregate counts.
mechanical_check: Source citation present; counts are integers.
name: ingest-incl-2xk-table

requirement_statement: Binary outcome encodable as Successes out of Cases.
name: ingest-incl-binary-outcome

requirement_statement: Total observations in the cell — the denominator for the success rate.
name: ingest-input-cases

requirement_statement: Every cell must name its stratum — the subgroup being stratified on.
mechanical_check: Non-empty string; consistent label for both A and B cells within the same stratum.
name: ingest-input-stratum

requirement_statement: Every cell row must name its parent study with a stable unique slug.
mechanical_check: Non-empty string; identical across all cells in the study; matches Studies.StudyId.
name: ingest-input-study

requirement_statement: Count of successful outcomes in the cell — the numerator.
name: ingest-input-successes

requirement_statement: Every cell must be labeled A or B — exactly two treatments per study.
mechanical_check: Value in {A, B}; both labels appear.
name: ingest-input-treatment

requirement_statement: Exactly two treatment arms (A and B) per study.
mechanical_check: Exactly two distinct TreatmentLabel values in CaseCells.
name: ingest-struct-binary-treatment

requirement_statement: Every stratum must have exactly one A-cell and one B-cell.
name: ingest-struct-paired-cells
